# Abhishek Kumar T | Aspiring Full Stack Developer

> Aspiring full-stack developer (React · Next.js · TypeScript) who also builds machine-learning
> systems. Student at Cauvery Institute of Technology, Mandya, Karnataka. Open to work.

This repository is view-only (see `LICENSE`). Single-page portfolio that assembles itself:
the 18 agents wire the blocks, type the copy, pick the accent, and a particle swarm spells
the finale message at the contact section. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind
CSS 4; the build engine (`src/lib/engine.ts`) is framework-agnostic and deliberately owns
every frame — no per-frame React state.

## Who

Abhishek Kumar T — Computer Science engineering student (B.E. CSE, 2023–2027), Cauvery Institute
of Technology, Mandya, Karnataka. India. GitHub: https://github.com/abhisheksharma611 ·
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhisheksharma611/

## What he does

Full-stack web development with React, Next.js and TypeScript on the front, and Python / Flask /
SQL on the back, with hands-on machine-learning work in between. Everything ships on GitHub.

## Flagship work

- **AI-Powered Email Spam Detection and Threat Analysis** (Python, Flask, fine-tuned RoBERTa,
  scikit-learn ensemble) — local-first Gmail spam and threat analyser with 6-class classification,
  risk/urgency/sender-reputation scores; ~97.3% on a held-out set of 2,055 emails.
  https://github.com/abhisheksharma611/AI-Powered-Email-Spam-Detection-and-Threat-Analysis
- **ABTalks Redesign** — redesign of the ABTalks 60-Day Coding Challenge for the Vibe Code
  Hackathon 2026. TypeScript. https://github.com/abhisheksharma611/abtalks-redesign
- **NexaAI Landing Page** — responsive brand page: dark-mode toggle, testimonial carousel,
  scroll-triggered animation, hamburger menu. HTML/CSS/JS.
  https://github.com/abhisheksharma611/NexaAI-Responsive-Landing-Page
- **Budget App (Expense Tracker)** — Python OOP budget manager with ledgers and transfer checks.
  https://github.com/abhisheksharma611/Expense-Tracker
- **Polygon Area Calculator** — Python OOP geometry toolkit.
  https://github.com/abhisheksharma611/Polygon-area-calculator-Python
